sections.content:
**`buildCoachContext` called independently per action** — `sendMessage`, `handlePepTalk`, and `generateOpeningMessage` each call `buildCoachContext(userId)` independently with no sharing. Three tab navigations away and back will trigger three independent multi-query fetches. The cache fix above solves this.

**`supabase.auth.getUser()` called in every async function**

`loadProfile`, `loadChatHistory`, `sendMessage`, `handlePepTalk`, `switchCoach`, `runSearch` — all call `supabase.auth.getUser()` independently. Cache it at component level:

```ts
const userRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

useEffect(() => {
  supabase.auth.getUser().then(({ data: { user } }) => {
    userRef.current = user?.id ?? null;
  });
}, []);
```

Then replace `await supabase.auth.getUser()` with `userRef.current` in all handlers. On a cold start this saves ~5 redundant auth reads.

---

**Summary table:**

| Issue | File | Impact | Fix effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| N+1: habits→completions in context | `context.ts:46` | High — every message | DB view / 60s cache |
| N+1: stats sequential queries | `StatsScreen:184` | Medium | Add to Promise.all |
| N+1: profile waterfall | `CoachScreen:300` | Medium | Merge into Promise.all |
| Re-render: inner component functions | `CoachScreen:566` | High — on every message | React.memo extraction |
| Re-render: renderMessage inline | `CoachScreen:618` | High | useCallback |
| Re-render: calendar IIFE | `StatsScreen:404` | Medium | React.memo extraction |
| Memory leak: searchDebounce | `CoachScreen:213` | Low | useEffect cleanup |
| Memory leak: recording animation | `CoachScreen:490` | Low | ref + cleanup |
| Redundant: getUser() per handler | `CoachScreen` | Medium | userRef cache |
| Redundant: context rebuild per message | `context.ts` | High | 60s TTL cache |

The highest ROI fixes are: **cache `buildCoachContext`** (eliminates 2+ DB round trips per message) and **extract `QuoteCard`/`TodayCard` to `React.memo`** (stops re-rendering header on every keystroke and message).
